calls.title: Entrata Homebody and Entrata Academy
calls.brief: Alex Rost, Kenneth, and Chris from Entrata discussed their comprehensive platform, highlighting its integrated Learning Management System (LMS) and single sign-on capabilities designed to streamline onboarding, training, and daily operations. The conversation emphasized Entrata's ability to consolidate various functions into one dashboard, improving accountability and efficiency for property management teams, while also addressing potential integrations and feature requests. Rachel, a Learning and Development Manager, shared her positive past experience with Entrata and provided valuable feedback on its advancements and potential to enhance user experience and resident satisfaction.

calls.title: Entrata Maintenance Demo: Alfred/RKW
calls.brief: Kenneth, Chris Baiocco and Alex from Entrata, along with Ksmith from RKW Residential, discussed Entrata's property management software, focusing on its maintenance platform, AI capabilities, and reporting features. Key highlights included the system's ability to streamline work order management, automate inspections, and provide detailed analytics for performance tracking, with a particular emphasis on the Facilities Pro add-on and its advanced AI functionalities for task assignment and resident communication. The conversation also touched upon the integration potential with existing systems and the benefits of a unified platform for improved efficiency and decision-making.

calls.title: Entrata Operations Demo: Alfred/RKW
calls.brief: Tijah, Kenneth, Chris and Alex from Entrata, along with Ksmith from RKW Residential, discussed Entrata's platform as a potential replacement for RealPage, highlighting its all-in-one functionality and seamless integration compared to RKW's current tech stack. The Entrata team showcased key features like the unified dashboard, customizable reporting, and resident portal, emphasizing the benefits of keeping core processes within a single system to streamline workflows and improve data accuracy. RKW expressed interest in exploring integrations with their existing tools, particularly Alfred, and further demos were scheduled to delve deeper into specific areas like accounting, maintenance, and marketing.

calls.title: Chorus - Entrata discovery with Jess (Alfred/ A Residential)

He's visiting to assess the feasibility of switching, focusing on data integration, resident interface, and the vendor's vision for the future of PMS products, particularly regarding automation, centralization, and risk management. Chris also offered his company as a potential operating partner for testing and collaborating on operational strategies.

calls.title: The Lane - Rent Plus Conversation
calls.brief: Sabrina and Nate from Entrata, along with Faith from Sunflower Management Group, discussed Entrata's identity theft protection and credit reporting service. Nate highlighted the benefits for residents and property management, including credit score improvement and a competitive advantage, with a clear pricing structure and profit margin for Sunflower. They also addressed implementation details, resident transitions, and potential challenges with existing residents, ultimately agreeing to move forward with further discussions and agreements for Sunflower's properties.

The conversation concluded with a plan for targeted demos to assess Entrata's suitability for Launch Property Management's growth and specific operational needs.

calls.title: Entrata | Aspen - Scoping Call
calls.brief: Miles, Martin and Callin from Entrata, along with Blake, Dan and Heather from Aspen One Housing, discussed the implementation of Entrata's software for Aspen One Housing's workforce and seasonal housing, focusing on the best way to structure properties within the system to accommodate both short-term and long-term leases, roommate matching, and data migration from Buildium. They explored using Entrata's student housing functionality for seasonal rentals and a two-step application process to streamline applicant assignment, and also reviewed the implementation timeline, data migration process, and ongoing support.

calls.title: Entrata Utilities in Colorado
calls.brief: Gerry, David and Miles from Entrata, along with Heather and Ganzini-Rasmussen from Aspen One Housing, discussed Entrata's utility billing capabilities in light of new Colorado legislation and Aspen's current utility management practices, including the potential for phased implementation and cost recovery strategies. Entrata presented its utility expense management program and addressed legal compliance, while Aspen One Housing explored the feasibility of integrating the service and its potential impact on their team's workload and financial performance. The call concluded with plans for a follow-up scoping call to finalize the agreement and establish implementation timelines.

calls.title: Entrata | Aspen
calls.brief: Miles from Entrata, along with Heather, Blake and Dan from Aspen One Housing, discussed the terms of a contract, including pricing, service modules, and implementation plans. Key points included clarifying the Master Service Agreement, addressing data privacy and security documentation, and strategizing on the rollout of various Entrata features like screening, insurance, and utility management. The conversation also touched on potential cost savings and compliance with state regulations, with a plan to finalize contracts and begin phased implementation.

calls.title: Entrata Introduction Call: Dustin & Melinda
calls.brief: Dustin from Entrata, along with Melinda from PLK Communities, discussed Entrata's platform as a potential future solution for PLK, though PLK is currently satisfied with ResMan and under contract. Melinda highlighted the importance of strong partnerships and seamless implementation, expressing concerns about switching from their current best-in-class systems and the potential loss of specific features. Dustin offered to provide informational materials and updates on Entrata's offerings for future consideration.

calls.title: CMP & Entrata | Scoping Call
calls.brief: Todd and Callin from Entrata, along with Mike and Jahala from Capstone Management Partners, discussed the scope of Capstone's Entrata implementation, covering data migration, training, third-party integrations, and website hosting, and addressed specific questions regarding legal documents and the implementation timeline. They agreed on a plan to launch properties in phases, starting with a small group to test different operational aspects, and will follow up with written summaries and legal team discussions. The team also discussed the possibility of using the Sim tool for Entrada to Entrada migrations, which is a self-initialized migration tool that Callin managed the project to build, and is substantially less expensive at $400.

calls.title: CMP & Entrata | Ancillary Revenue Discussion
calls.brief: Alyssa, Cory, Cassie and Todd from Entrata, along with Jahala and Mike from Capstone Management Partners, discussed Entrata's pricing proposal, focusing on ancillary revenue projections from rent reporting, insurance products, and the "Homebody Guarantee," while also addressing California-specific regulations and potential cost-saving measures. Capstone Management Partners expressed a need to reduce initial costs, proposing a more conservative approach to ancillary revenue projections and a potential ramp-up pricing structure, with a target contract signing in early March following internal reviews. They also scheduled a scoping call for the following week to address outstanding questions, including legal aspects and data transition from Cardinal Group.

calls.title: CMP & Entrata | Pricing & Product Q&A
calls.brief: Cory, Cassie, Todd and Brandon from Entrata, along with Mike and Jahala from Capstone Management Partners, discussed Entrata's product offerings, pricing structures, and implementation plans. Key highlights included clarifying the functionality and pricing of Entrata's Academy Elite for training, the nuances of their blanket master policy versus individual renter's insurance, and the detailed breakdown of various bundle pricing for Capstone's diverse property portfolio. The conversation also touched upon utility reporting, data sharing, and the projected timeline for implementation, with a focus on refining revenue projections and addressing specific property service level needs.

calls.title: CMP & Entrata | Sales Order Prep
calls.brief: Entrata team members, along with Jahala Akins and Mike from Capstone Management Partners, discussed finalizing the Entrata product bundle for Capstone, focusing on tailoring product sets for full-service and revised property management activities, including a new resident portal app (RXP) and AI services. Capstone will review the proposed bundles, pricing, and customization options, aiming to provide feedback by the end of the week, with a focus on streamlining the agreement and ensuring alignment across their teams.

calls.title: Confirmed - Asset Living x Centurion | Business Consulting Scoping Call
calls.brief: Trenton, Alicia, Joseph and Casey from Entrata, along with Greg, Aldo and Adam from Centurion Property Group, discussed an audit of Centurion's Entrata usage to optimize existing features, identify unused contracted products for implementation, and explore opportunities to consolidate third-party software within the Entrata platform, with a focus on streamlining operations and improving workflows for Centurion's ten properties. Centurion will provide a list of their current external products for Entrata to analyze and propose equivalent solutions. The next step is for Entrata to create a formal proposal for the audit and subsequent consultations.

calls.title: Entrata/CPG - Deeper dive into BI and Centralization
calls.brief: The call focused on demonstrating Entrata's centralized leasing dashboard and Business Intelligence (BI) tool to Aldo, who expressed interest in streamlining leasing operations and gaining better data insights. Key discussion points included access controls, custom reporting capabilities, and the potential to integrate external data sources like Excel spreadsheets. Aldo was satisfied with the tool's capabilities and requested a proposal, also suggesting Entrata develop call optionality within the system.

calls.title: Entrata | Park Properties | Accounting Demo
calls.brief: Libby and Jin from Entrata, along with Diane and Afletcher from Park Properties Management Co., discussed Entrata's accounting features, including chart of accounts, vendor management, customizable approval workflows, budgeting, and reporting capabilities, with a focus on how these features could streamline Park Properties' processes. Park Properties inquired about specific functionalities like utility bill processing, per-unit reporting, and intercompany transactions, and Entrata offered to provide more detailed demonstrations based on their specific needs.

calls.title: Park Properties + Entrata Call
calls.brief: Nathan and Jin from Entrata, along with Afletcher from Park Properties Management Co., discussed Park Properties' potential transition from Yardi to Entrata, focusing on Entrata's ability to support their current tech stack and integrations. Entrata confirmed its capabilities to handle most of Park Properties' needs, with the exception of Deposit Cloud, and outlined a scoping process to ensure a smooth transition, addressing concerns about data integrity and system reliability. Afletcher expressed interest in upcoming demos and the scoping experience, emphasizing the importance of minimizing business disruptions during the transition.

calls.title: Jin / Alice Connect
calls.brief: Tom, Jin, Matthew and Kayla from Entrata, along with Afletcher from Park Properties Management Co., discussed Park Properties' affordable housing programs, focusing on tax credit, tax bond, and RD properties, to tailor an upcoming Entrata demo. Entrata confirmed support for tax credit and bond programs, but not RD, and explored potential workarounds and future development plans, while Afletcher highlighted online leasing as a critical pain point needing immediate improvement. Entrata will showcase customizable online leasing features in the demo.

calls.title: Park Properties + Entrata | Demo
calls.brief: Matthew, Tom, Libby and Jin from Entrata, along with Afletcher, Afletcher and Stacey from Park Properties Management Co., discussed Entrata's platform and its potential to streamline Park Properties' operations, focusing on consolidating systems, improving reporting, and automating processes for both conventional and affordable housing units. Key areas of interest included the resident portal, AI capabilities, revenue intelligence, and the handling of affordable housing compliance, with a plan for follow-up meetings to delve deeper into specific areas like compliance, facilities, and accounting. The overall goal was to assess Entrata's ability to replace existing systems like Yardi, Knock, Residesk and NOC and improve efficiency for Park Properties.

calls.title: Amy/James sync
calls.brief: James from Entrata, along with Amy from Metropolitan Holdings, discussed Entrata's pricing structure, potential IPO, and the terms and conditions of a potential partnership. Key highlights included Entrata's approach to revenue share based on transaction volume rather than tiered pricing, their preparation for predictable growth, and a detailed review of contract clauses related to property removal and liability. The conversation also touched upon Metropolitan Holdings' ongoing vendor evaluation, with a focus on Entrata's innovation and long-term partnership potential, and a timeline for finalizing the agreement before Amy's vacation.

calls.title: Amy / James MHL Entrata
calls.brief: James from Entrata, along with Amy from Metropolitan Holdings, discussed Entrata's software offerings, focusing on pricing, features, and integration capabilities. Key highlights included clarifying payment schedules, the benefits of Entrata's AI invoice processing, and the potential for Entrata's "junior analyst" query function to rival third-party tools. They also explored the value of Entrata's Marketing Hub and the strategic importance of Business Intelligence for Metropolitan Holdings' long-term goals.

calls.title: Marketing Hub & DMB
calls.brief: Alex and James from Entrata, along with Amy and Allison from Metropolitan Holdings, discussed Entrata's marketing solutions, including the Marketing Strategy Hub and Digital Marketing Bundle, and how they could address Metropolitan Holdings' needs for better lead source attribution and reporting. The conversation also delved into pricing, contract terms, and a comparison with Yardi, with a focus on Entrata's potential to streamline operations and provide a unified data experience, though significant price differences and existing vendor relationships presented challenges. Ultimately, the decision hinges on Entrata's ability to demonstrate clear value and competitive pricing to justify the investment for Metropolitan Holdings.

calls.title: Metropolitan Q&A on Advanced Budgeting
calls.brief: Alex and James from Entrata, along with Kelsey, Amy and Dalton from Metropolitan Holdings, discussed Entrata's advanced budgeting tool, focusing on its ability to handle granular budgeting, versioning, and integration with existing data. Metropolitan Holdings expressed interest in features like unit-type expense projections, pro forma integration, and the potential for AI-driven forecasting, with Entrata highlighting the system's single data layer and drill-down capabilities as key differentiators. The call concluded with a positive assessment from Metropolitan Holdings, confirming the tool's structural alignment with their needs and a plan for future discussions on pricing and marketing.

calls.title: Entrata Metropolitan Proposal Walkthrough
calls.brief: James from Entrata, along with Amy from Metropolitan Holdings, discussed a sales order for Entrata's software, covering pricing, features, implementation, and potential cost-saving strategies. They reviewed various components, including core packages, add-ons, and transactional fees, with Amy focusing on functionality, training, and integration with existing systems, and James aiming to tailor the proposal to Metropolitan Holdings' specific needs and secure the deal. Amy will provide the legal entity name and review the updated document, with the goal of finalizing the decision by the end of the week.

calls.title: Metropolitan Entrata Scoping Call
calls.brief: Callin and James from Entrata, along with Dalton and Amy from Metropolitan Holdings, discussed the implementation of Entrata's property management system, focusing on timelines, data migration strategies, training, and support. Amy and her team expressed their needs and concerns, particularly around data migration, support availability, and the potential for a phased implementation, while James and Callin outlined Entrata's capabilities and offered solutions tailored to Metropolitan Holdings' specific requirements. The call concluded with plans for follow-up meetings to discuss pricing, budgeting, and marketing strategies, with a goal of presenting a comprehensive proposal to Andrew by the 10th.

calls.title: Metropolitan Entrata Demo
calls.brief: James and Alex from Entrata, along with Amy and Dalton from Metropolitan Holdings, discussed Metropolitan Holdings' needs and timeline for a new property management system, focusing on Entrata's Business Intelligence (BI) tool and its capabilities, including customization, data integration, and AI features. They also covered implementation, support, pricing, and potential add-ons like lead nurturing, website options, and digital marketing services, aiming to align Entrata's offerings with Metropolitan Holdings' long-term goals and ensure a comprehensive solution. The next steps involve Entrata providing a formal proposal and scheduling an implementation call to discuss the rollout process.

calls.title: Entrata Financial Demo
calls.brief: James and Alex from Entrata, along with Dalton, Amy and Andrew from Metropolitan Holdings, discussed Entrata's capabilities, focusing on financial reporting, permission settings, and the learning management system, while also exploring potential integrations with existing systems and third-party platforms. Metropolitan Holdings is evaluating Entrata as a potential PMS solution and is particularly interested in its ability to handle complex property structures, streamline workflows, and provide actionable insights for improved resident experiences and strategic decision-making. The call concluded with action items for Entrata to provide further information, demos, and references to support Metropolitan Holdings' evaluation process.

calls.title: Resident Ops Entrata Demo for Metropolitan
calls.brief: Alex and James from Entrata, along with Jeff, Amy and Dalton from Metropolitan Holdings, discussed Entrata's maintenance, resident portal, reporting, and renewal features, focusing on Metropolitan's specific needs and workflows. The Metropolitan team expressed interest in the new make-ready board, inspection capabilities, AI-powered work order management, and customizable reporting, with plans to further explore the financial aspects with Andrew and schedule follow-up meetings. The team also discussed the possibility of implementing the new system gradually to avoid overwhelming the team.

calls.title: Entrata Demo for Metropolitan Lead to Lease
calls.brief: James and Alex from Entrata, along with Dalton and Amy from Metropolitan Holdings, discussed Entrata's platform capabilities, focusing on a potential switch from Appfolio, and explored features like customizable dashboards, a rewards program, BI tools, and AI-driven solutions for maintenance and renewals. Metropolitan Holdings expressed interest in a consolidated platform with a luxury feel, emphasizing the importance of a seamless resident experience and efficient data tracking, while also raising concerns about the timing of implementation and the need for a well-defined plan. Entrata will provide further demos and proposals tailored to Metropolitan Holdings' specific needs and timeline.

calls.title: Entrata/Metropolitan intro for Amy
calls.brief: Alex and James from Entrata, along with Amy from Metropolitan Holdings, discussed Metropolitan's need for a new property management system to replace their expiring AppFolio contract, focusing on immediate priorities like lead nurturing, data analytics, and CRM. Entrata is positioning itself as a solution to address these needs, offering a unified database system and tailored implementation, with plans for upcoming demos to showcase their capabilities to Amy and Andrew. The goal is to determine if Entrata can provide a more integrated and efficient solution compared to their current fragmented software stack and potentially replace Findigs.

calls.title: Entrata Pricing Overview for Metropolitan
calls.brief: James from Entrata discussed a potential software switch with Jessica, focusing on cost comparisons with their current Appfolio setup and RealPage, and exploring Entrata's features like revenue intelligence, rewards programs, and utility management. Jessica is gathering internal team feedback and pricing from competitors to make an informed decision, with a focus on ease of use and potential revenue generation. The next steps involve scheduling demos and calls to clarify specific features and address concerns before a final decision is made.

calls.title: Entrata Resident Operations for Metropolitan
calls.brief: The company is evaluating Entrata as a potential replacement for their current property management software, Folio, focusing on its CRM capabilities, fraud detection, and ability to streamline processes. Key decision factors include integration with existing systems, pricing, and the ability to manage complex property structures, with a rollout plan targeting new properties first. The team is also considering Entrata's training academy and AI features, while weighing the benefits of a single database system against the potential challenges of transitioning from their current setup.

calls.title: Entrata Accounting demo for Metropolitan
calls.brief: The call served to gather information from Dalton about Metropolitan's pain points with Appfolio, particularly regarding journal entry approvals, move-out reviews, GL account errors, and reporting limitations, to tailor the upcoming Entrata accounting demo. Key areas of focus for the demo will include approval workflows, customizable reporting, utility management solutions, and PO functionality, with a potential on-site visit for the resident operations demo. The team also discussed involving relevant personnel like Derek (utilities) and Addy in future discussions and demos.

calls.title: Entrata Q&A for Jessica at Metro
calls.brief: Jessica and James discussed Metro's potential transition from AppFolio to Entrata, focusing on AppFolio's limitations in website integration, lead management, and reporting, which are impacting revenue and marketing effectiveness. Jessica is seeking a unified platform to improve efficiency, reduce wasted marketing spend, and streamline operations, and will present a business case for change to the COO and owner next week. They will schedule follow-up demos with Entrata to explore solutions for marketing, resident operations, and accounting, aiming for a potential contract signing by the end of September.

calls.title: Resident Portal/Websites and Screening demo: JLL/Entrata
calls.brief: Nathan, Vincent and Alex from Entrata, along with Ariana.Rasansky and Mendowa, discussed Entrata's resident portal, website capabilities, and fraud prevention tools, highlighting features like amenity reservations, document management, and AI-driven income verification. The conversation also touched upon website customization, SEO management, and the integration of Entrata's offerings with JLL's existing systems, with a focus on streamlining processes and enhancing resident experience. Next steps involve pricing discussions and compliance review, with a proposal to be provided in the coming weeks.

calls.title: RXP Demo-Entrata+ JLL
calls.brief: Madison, Alex Buchanan and Alex Rost from Entrata, along with Mendowa from JLL, discussed Entrata's RXP resident portal, highlighting its customization options, integration capabilities, and potential to replace multiple existing JLL solutions. The demo focused on the platform's ability to streamline resident workflows, manage vendor integrations, and offer a more cohesive user experience, with JLL expressing interest in its white-labeling and access control features. A follow-up demo on resident portal websites and screening is scheduled for the following Monday.

calls.title: JLL Marketing demo with Entrata
calls.brief: Collin, Alex and Madison from Entrata, along with Ariana.Rasansky and Mendowa from JLL, discussed Entrata's digital marketing services, website capabilities, and resident portal features, with JLL expressing interest in website examples, integration with Yardi, and the potential for white-labeling the resident app. JLL raised concerns about consultant turnover and the costs associated with custom websites, and the group agreed to schedule a follow-up meeting in early January to discuss screening processes and an RXP demo.

calls.title: JLL Ancillary Revenue demo with Entrata
calls.brief: Entrata team members, along with Sheryl.Murphy, Mendowa, Ariana.Rasansky and Lela, discussed Entrata's utility management, insurance programs, rent reporting, and rewards programs, highlighting features like utility bill auditing, insurance verification, credit building, and resident loyalty incentives. The JLL team inquired about compliance with local regulations, revenue tracking, and the effectiveness of these programs in improving resident behavior and reducing costs. JLL expressed interest in Entrata's ability to provide data-driven insights and streamline processes, particularly in utility management and resident engagement.

calls.title: Affordable Demo with Entrata + JLL
calls.brief: Alex, Kayla, Madison and Matthew Segura from Entrata, along with Ariana.Rasansky and Mendowa, discussed Entrata's affordable housing software capabilities, focusing on ARO compliance and integration with JLL's existing processes, and the potential for future implementation. JLL expressed interest in Entrata's ancillary products, marketing website features, and resident portal, with plans to initiate compliance discussions in January and explore a contract buyout to facilitate an earlier implementation. The current Yardi contract extends until July 2026.

calls.title: Entrata CRM Demo with JLL
calls.brief: Alex and Madison from Entrata, along with Sheryl.Murphy, Jeffp.Thompson, Tommy.Rayjr, Mendowa and Tim.Peot, discussed Entrata's capabilities as a potential solution for JLL Property Management, focusing on its CRM, affordable housing workflows, analytics, and compliance features, with the goal of understanding how Entrata can be utilized alongside Yardi and within JLL's existing tech stack. JLL expressed interest in Entrata's automation, customization, and reporting features, particularly for lead management, resident communication, and financial processes, while also raising concerns about compliance, data security, and integration with existing systems. The call concluded with plans for future discussions on Yardi integration, compliance, insurance, utilities, and website customization options, including Entrata's "homebody rxp" for client branding.

calls.title: JLL +Entrata Accounting demo
calls.brief: Madison and Alex from Entrata, along with Lela, Tim.Peot, Tommy.Rayjr and Sheryl.Murphy from JLL Property Management, discussed the potential of layering Entrata on top of Yardi for JLL's multifamily and mixed-use properties, focusing on data transfer between the systems and addressing accounting and compliance concerns. The call concluded with a plan to schedule two separate demos: one for the CRM and multifamily side, and another for the commercial side, simulating Entrata as the front end and Yardi as the back end, and to provide client references.

calls.title: JLL Affordable Conversation w/ Entrata
calls.brief: Kayla, Madison, Alex and Matthew from Entrata, along with Mendowa and Lela, discussed Entrata's affordable housing platform and its capabilities, particularly the upcoming Affordable Wheels engine program, to address JLL's needs in managing affordable housing programs like ARO. The conversation highlighted Entrata's ability to handle complex program requirements, automate compliance processes, and integrate with existing workflows, ultimately aiming to streamline JLL's affordable housing management and reduce manual processes. A follow-up meeting was scheduled to delve deeper into specific compliance workflows and involve additional JLL team members.

calls.title: JLL Re-sync with Entrata
calls.brief: Vincent and Madison from Entrata, along with Mendowa and Lela, discussed the potential implementation of Entrata's property management software for JLL Property Management, focusing on integrating with their existing Yardi accounting system and addressing concerns around affordable housing management and international portfolios. They agreed to schedule follow-up calls with Entrata's accounting and affordable housing experts to address specific technical questions and explore the feasibility of the transition, with a decision expected in late Q3 or early Q4.

calls.title: Maddy/Mendowa chat Entrata+ JLL
calls.brief: Madison from Entrata, along with Mendowa from JLL, discussed the potential for JLL to adopt Entrata, driven by a potential deal with Oc Vibe, a large mixed-use development client that requires Entrata. Mendowa clarified that securing the Oc Vibe deal is crucial for expanding Entrata usage within JLL, and they explored the possibility of onboarding Entrata with a smaller, existing JLL client in Florida in the interim. Madison offered to connect Mendowa with Entrata resources to address compliance and integration concerns, particularly regarding affordable housing and the integration of commercial and residential operations.

calls.title: Connor/Reed: Entrata + Devon
calls.brief: Connor from Entrata, along with Reed from Devon Properties Ltd, discussed the evolving Canadian prop tech market and Devon's growth strategy, which focuses on expanding their multi-family offerings and integrating technology. They explored various software solutions, including Entrata, RealPage, and Yardi, highlighting the challenges of data integration and the importance of a unified platform. Both expressed interest in future collaboration and potential adoption of Entrata's solutions.

calls.title: Chris + Connor: Devon/Entrata Sync
calls.brief: Connor Patterson from Entrata reached out to Connor to discuss Entrata's property management software and its potential application for Devin's company, particularly in Western Canada. Connor sees an opportunity to leverage Entrata to potentially replace RealPage at Devin's company and offered his Winnipeg portfolio as a proof of concept, while also exploring potential partnerships with Entrata for future expansion. Connor Patterson offered a demonstration of Entrata and mentioned a potential lead for Devin from a US-based construction firm expanding into British Columbia.

calls.title: Entrata + UnitiiPM: Pricing Proposal
calls.brief: Connor from Entrata, along with MBA from Unitii PM, discussed Entrata's comprehensive property management software suite, including core bundle pricing, implementation and migration costs, and various add-on tools. Key discussion points revolved around payment processing fees, resident screening options, and the standard implementation and training processes for new partners. The conversation concluded with a plan for follow-up after Unitii PM reviews the pricing and consults with their team and owners.

calls.title: Connor/Rob: Entrata Pre-demo
calls.brief: Connor from Entrata, along with Robert from Unitii PM, discussed the upcoming Entrata demo for Unitii PM, focusing on key features like accounting, leasing, and resident management, with the goal of potentially replacing Yardi. They reviewed the demo agenda, confirmed attendees, and addressed Unitii PM's timeline for a decision, aiming for a potential switch by April 30th, while also discussing the property list and commercial property management.

calls.title: Connor / Shirleen: Pre-Demo Call
calls.brief: Connor from Entrata, along with Shirleen and Dmitry from Unitii PM, discussed Unitii's current accounting processes using Yardi Voyager, focusing on month-end close, accounts payable workflows, and reporting needs. Entrata highlighted potential improvements with their system, including automated intercompany transactions, flexible reporting, and a job costing module for project management, while also addressing Unitii's specific concerns about data entry errors, purchase order management, and budgeting. The call concluded with plans for a detailed demo of Entrata's capabilities, tailored to Unitii's key areas of interest.

calls.title: Connor/Lizaine: Entrata Pre-Demo Call
calls.brief: Connor from Entrata, along with Lizaine from Unitii PM, discussed Unitii PM's needs and concerns regarding a potential switch from Yardi to Entrata, focusing on lease signing automation, accounting integration, and owner reporting. Lizaine emphasized the importance of meeting both operational and accounting requirements, especially considering the impact on a major owner with 1,000 units, while Connor highlighted Entrata's strengths in these areas and its ability to integrate with existing systems. Pricing and potential cost savings were also identified as key considerations for Unitii PM.

calls.title: Connor/Stephanie: Entrata Pre-Demo Call
calls.brief: Connor from Entrata discussed with Stephanie their current operational challenges, particularly around reporting, renewals, and maintenance workflows, and how Entrata's platform could streamline these processes through automation and integration. Stephanie highlighted the need for better oversight and checks and balances within the system, and Connor emphasized Entrata's capabilities in these areas, including automated reporting, a centralized renewal process, and a facilities management app. They also discussed the possibility of Stephanie attending a demo in Calgary to further explore Entrata's potential solutions.

calls.title: Connor / Rob: Pre-Demo Call
calls.brief: Connor from Entrata, along with Robert from Unitii PM, discussed Entrata's potential to replace Unitii PM's current Yardi system, focusing on Entrata's superior accounting capabilities, BI dashboard, and streamlined operational processes, particularly lease management and work orders. Robert emphasized the importance of Entrata's accounting features and reporting capabilities, while Connor highlighted Entrata's ability to reduce manual labor and provide real-time data insights, aiming for a decision by the end of the process.

calls.title: Connor / Vicky: Pre-Demo Call
calls.brief: Connor from Entrata, along with Vicky from Unitii PM, discussed Unitii PM's current operational inefficiencies, particularly regarding multiple software systems and manual processes, and how Entrata's integrated platform could streamline workflows, improve reporting, and reduce costs. Vicky expressed interest in Entrata's operational capabilities but raised concerns about the accounting side and reporting requirements for owners, which Connor addressed by highlighting Entrata's customizable reporting features and ease of use for finance teams.

calls.title: Entrata + UnitiiPM: Intro Call
calls.brief: Connor from Entrata, along with Unitii PM team members, discussed the potential for Entrata's unified platform to replace Unitii PM's current fragmented system, addressing challenges with manual processes and inefficient workflows. Unitii PM expressed interest in a demo focusing on the tenant lifecycle and accounting perspectives, with a decision needed before their Yardi renewal on April 30th. Connor proposed in-person demos in Calgary in early February and offered resources to help Unitii PM evaluate Entrata's capabilities.

calls.title: Havenpark & Entrata | Workflow Review
calls.brief: Todd, John, Stephen and Brandon from Entrata, along with Katie and Jay from Havenpark Communities, discussed Havenpark's complex inventory workflows and SOS statuses, identifying key areas for potential automation and standardization. The conversation highlighted the manual nature of many processes, particularly around status updates and approvals, and explored how Entrata could bridge gaps and improve product understanding. The teams agreed to further explore visual workflow mapping and potential automation solutions in future discussions.

calls.title: Havenpark & Entrata | Prep w/ Katie for Dec 8
calls.brief: Todd and Brandon from Entrata, along with Katie from Havenpark Communities, discussed Havenpark's current operational inefficiencies and how Entrata's platform could address them, focusing on resident communication, move-in/move-out processing, work orders, site violations, AI implementation, and data integration with existing systems like Coupa and Sage. The call served to map Havenpark's current tech stack and processes to Entrata's modules in preparation for a more in-depth meeting. They also discussed a potential social gathering before the meeting.

Tyrus emphasized Entrata's single-platform advantage and offered references from companies who switched from Rent Manager.

They scheduled a demo for the 27th to discuss Entrata's capabilities and pricing, with a potential implementation timeline of around 90 days.

calls.title: Entrata-HACS Discussion
calls.brief: Beaumon and Berkley from Entrata, along with Dominique from Housing Authority of the City of Shreveport, discussed the Housing Authority's need for a modern property management software solution to replace PHA Web, focusing on improved financial reporting, maintenance processes, and resident communication for their mixed-income and affordable housing properties. Entrata offered to provide tailored demos showcasing their capabilities in these areas, including resident portals, mobile maintenance, and affordable housing compliance, with a focus on property management in the initial demo. calls.brief: Jon, Rolanda and James from Entrata, along with Kayla from LBC Property management, discussed Entrata's features, including lead-to-lease automation, resident communication, accounting functionalities, and reporting capabilities, with a focus on how Entrata can streamline LBC's processes and improve efficiency. LBC expressed interest in automating processes like invoice processing and utility billing, and requested pricing information and a follow-up session on maintenance features. The call concluded with plans for future discussions and demonstrations tailored to LBC's specific needs.

calls.title: Entrata Demo Q&A for LBC
calls.brief: James and Jon from Entrata, along with Robb and Anne from LBC Property management, discussed LBC's current property management processes using Buildium and how Entrata could potentially improve them, focusing on both residential and commercial properties. They planned upcoming demos to showcase Entrata's capabilities, including a high-level overview for Mina and deeper dives into specific functionalities like accounting and commercial management for the team, and scheduled an implementation scoping call to discuss the transition process. The goal is to determine if Entrata is a good fit for LBC's needs and to potentially consolidate their accounting and reporting processes.

calls.title: Call with LBC Property management - Anne Perry
calls.brief: James from Entrata called Anne to reschedule their meeting due to a family emergency, and they agreed to a shorter call on Tuesday to discuss commercial functionality. They rescheduled the full demo for the first week of December, planning a lunch and learn session with pizza sponsored by Entrata, and discussed the potential benefits of switching from Buildium to Entrata, including addressing the need for an "apply now" button and exploring historical data access. James will send the general terms to their attorney for review and update the calendar invite.

calls.title: Entrata Product Review
calls.brief: James from Entrata, along with Anne from LBC Property Management, discussed transitioning LBC's property management to Entrata, focusing on streamlining operations, consolidating systems, and generating new revenue streams through features like blanket insurance policies and a rewards program. They outlined a plan for a demo to showcase Entrata's capabilities and address specific needs, including CRM, online leasing, and revenue intelligence, with a focus on a phased implementation approach. James will provide Anne with a detailed proposal and supporting materials to facilitate internal discussions and decision-making.

calls.title: Entrata Discovery Call
calls.brief: James and Berkley from Entrata, along with Anne from LBC Property management, discussed transitioning LBC from Buildium to Entrata, focusing on LBC's needs, Entrata's product offerings, and a timeline for implementation. Anne, recently hired to "level up" LBC, expressed interest in a comprehensive solution to replace Buildium, and James outlined Entrata's unified platform and its benefits, including AI integration and revenue-sharing opportunities. They scheduled a follow-up call to review products, pricing, and a demo for key stakeholders, aiming for a potential switch by February.

TF Cornerstone outlined their current tech stack, challenges with their existing system, and specific needs for their portfolio of multifamily and commercial properties, including affordable housing compliance and AI implementation. Ed cited team familiarity with Yardi as the primary reason for their decision, and Berkley ended the call after acknowledging their choice.

opportunities.name: Elizabeth Property Group - Full Platform Affordable

calls.title: Entrata|EPG - Scoping Call
calls.brief: Jacob and Callin from Entrata, along with Lindsay from Elizabeth Property Group, discussed finalizing the contract, addressing concerns from Carlton (another property management company under EPG), and outlining the implementation plan for Entrata's software, including training, data migration, and BI tool setup. Lindsay will call Tisha to level set on the contract and Carlton's concerns, and Entrata will proceed with the assumption that EPG will have 80% decision-making power over the implementation, with Carlton having 20% influence. The initial property go-live is planned for late March or early April, with in-person consultations scheduled for the week of January 26th.

calls.title: Entrata | EPG - Affordable Program Layering
calls.brief: Entrata team members, along with Virginia, Lindsay, Sabine and Tisha from Elizabeth Property Group, discussed Elizabeth Property Group's potential transition to Entrata, focusing on Entrata's capabilities in managing affordable housing programs and addressing concerns from Carlton (Elizabeth Property Group) based on outdated information. They agreed to prioritize the Canterbury property for the initial Entrata implementation, aiming for a February or March transition, and to schedule in-person consulting at Entrata's headquarters in Salt Lake City in January.

calls.title: Entrata|EPG - Owner/Investor Tools - Discussion
calls.brief: Jacob, Karline, Sara and Stephanie from Entrata, along with Virginia, Lindsay and Sabine from Elizabeth Property Group, discussed Entrata's new asset management platform designed to streamline operations, improve decision-making, and enhance risk management for ownership groups. Elizabeth Property Group provided feedback on the prototype, highlighting the need for utility management, robust Business Intelligence (BI), and fraud detection capabilities. Entrata emphasized the platform's ability to standardize data across multiple property management companies and integrate with existing systems, offering a potential solution for Elizabeth Property Group's goals of quick data access, SOP enforcement, and data ownership.

calls.title: Entrata|EPG - Introduction to K.O.
calls.brief: Jacob from Entrata, along with Virginia, Tisha, K.O. and Lindsay, discussed Elizabeth Property Group's potential transition to Entrata, focusing on data hosting options and streamlining internal processes. K.O., an experienced Entrata user, shared her expertise in managing a similar transition with multiple property management companies, highlighting the benefits of Elizabeth Property Group hosting the data and controlling GL codes. The group explored support structures, staffing needs, and potential challenges, scheduling a follow-up call to continue the discussion.

calls.title: Entrata|EPG - Rollout Discussion
calls.brief: Kayla, Karline, Callin and Jacob from Entrata, along with Sabine, Lindsay and Virginia from Elizabeth Property Group, discussed the timeline and logistics for migrating Elizabeth Property Group's properties to Entrata, focusing on potential roadblocks related to LIHTC reporting deadlines, existing contracts with other providers, and upcoming takeovers and lease-ups. They agreed to expedite the contracting process, schedule a meeting with a migration consultant, and review a pricing proposal to facilitate a smooth transition with minimal uncertainties. The group also discussed the importance of operator involvement in the initial configuration of the database and data migration.

calls.title: Erich/Bryce Connect - Virtual
calls.brief: Bryce from Entrata, along with Erich from Dayrise Residential, discussed Dayrise's current frustrations with RealPage, their openness to considering Entrata in the future, and the potential for Entrata's AI and unified platform to address Dayrise's needs, particularly in back-office functions. Erich emphasized the importance of a solution-focused approach and the need for Entrata to demonstrate a clear understanding of Dayrise's business challenges and the value proposition of switching PMS providers, while also acknowledging the challenges of switching PMS providers. They agreed to continue the conversation, focusing on Entrata's investments and Dayrise's priorities, including a product meeting with Entrata's product team.

calls.title: Dayrise + Entrata | Accounting Overview
calls.brief: The Entrata team presented Dayrise with an overview of their accounting functionality, emphasizing its real-time, single-database architecture and automated features for accounts receivable and payable. Dayrise expressed interest in Entrata's ability to streamline reconciliation, manage vendor invoices, and customize reporting, particularly for month-end closes and integration with Power BI. The call concluded with a positive reception and plans for continued discussion.

calls.title: Entrata Proposal Review
calls.brief: David, George and Cory from Entrata, along with Kevin and Richard from E & S Ring Management Corporation, discussed the postponement of Entrata implementation until 2028 due to a major renovation project and the board's concerns about disruption. Despite the delay, both parties agreed to finalize the MSA to establish a framework for future collaboration, with Entrata offering to help identify potential acquisition opportunities for E & S Ring Management Corporation. The call ended with both parties reaffirming their positive relationship and commitment to working together when the timing is right.

calls.title: Entrata MSA - Legal Review - E&S Ring
calls.brief: George from Entrata, along with Kevin from E & S Ring Management Corporation, discussed the terms of their agreement, focusing on data security, liability, pricing, and service level agreements. Key points included concerns about data backup procedures, limitations on liability, price protection for new properties, and the need for a termination clause in the SLA, with both parties agreeing to further refine the draft asynchronously. The goal is to finalize the agreement by the end of the year.

calls.title: Chorus - Entrata / E&S Ring - Recurring
calls.brief: The call focused on solidifying the transition from Yardi to Entrata, including finalizing the MSA, preparing for an executive meeting with the owner Brett Morgan to showcase Entrata's AI capabilities, and strategizing around potential resistance from within Kevin's team. Kennedy Wilson's new property management ventures and their impact on existing relationships were also discussed, along with strategies to address potential cost increases. The Entrata team is working to ensure a smooth transition and demonstrate the value of their platform to all stakeholders.

They explored flexible billing options to ease the transition and the potential for consolidating existing rent sync tools into Entrata. Connor offered an executive brief to help Mohammad present the proposal to his team for a decision.

calls.title: Connor/Hunter Sync

Hunter expressed support for Entrata but noted executive-level risk aversion, particularly from the CEO, Chad, and a desire to explore Entrata's asset management features, with a potential target implementation in 2027. Connor offered to meet the team in person and emphasized Entrata's ability to consolidate data and improve workflows, aiming for demos that would resonate with both operations and finance.

calls.title: Chorus - Connor + Gavin Sync: Entrata + Mainline

Gavin highlighted Mainline's aggressive growth and the challenges posed by their current systems, emphasizing the need for a solution that improves efficiency, reporting, and employee engagement. Connor Patterson positioned Entrata as a user-friendly, all-in-one platform that can streamline operations and scale with Mainline's growth, offering a demo and further discussions to explore a potential partnership.

calls.title: Chorus - Connor + Ryan | Entrata + Mainline Living

Ryan expressed interest in Entrata's modularity, ease of use, and native solutions for inspections and resident rewards, particularly in comparison to their current Yardi system, and is looking forward to a demo tailored to their specific pain points. Connor emphasized Entrata's ability to handle complex scenarios like pre-construction leasing, rent control, and affordable housing components, aiming to reduce reliance on manual processes.

The key decision-makers for a potential switch include Melissa, Alicia, and Doug, with possible investor/owner approval needed.

calls.title: Elevate Living + Entrata, Platform Demo
calls.brief: Blake and Erick from Entrata, along with Landon, Julie and Kyle from Elevate Living, discussed Entrata's property management software, focusing on core operations, resident lifecycle management, and AI capabilities. Elevate Living expressed a strong interest in robust, pre-built AI solutions for various functions, including reporting and automation, and will internally discuss whether Entrata's AI offerings meet their needs before proceeding further. The call concluded with Entrata offering to provide further information and potentially involve their President to address Elevate Living's AI-related concerns.

calls.title: Elevate Living + Entrata, Pre-Demo and Business Discovery Call
calls.brief: Erick and Blake from Entrata, along with Julie from Elevate Living, discussed Elevate Living's pain points with Yardi, focusing on operational inefficiencies, reporting limitations, and the unit turn process. Entrata presented its platform as a comprehensive solution with AI capabilities, customizable workflows, and a unified database to address these challenges and improve efficiency. The call concluded with a plan for a detailed demo of Entrata's features, including revenue-generating solutions and integration with third-party tools.

calls.title: Meeting with Julie Williamson
calls.brief: Blake from Entrata, along with Julie from Elevate Living, discussed Elevate Living's frustrations with their current property management software (Yardi) and their interest in exploring Entrata as a potential solution, focusing on AI capabilities and streamlined workflows. Elevate Living is in the early stages of evaluating options, with Yardi contracts expiring in April of next year, and a demo with Entrata is scheduled for either December 8th, 9th, or 12th, preceded by a planning call on December 2nd.

calls.title: Byron Properties + Entrata (Utilities Discussion)
calls.brief: Gerry, Evan and Jon from Entrata, along with Taylor and Tracy from Byron Properties, discussed Entrata's utility billing services, including resident bill back and bill management, with a focus on common area billing and the possibility of combining utility line items. Byron Properties is considering Entrata for utility management but is also evaluating another vendor, with a decision expected by the end of the year, and they are aiming to postpone the utility setup by about six months due to their current workload. Entrata will provide finalized pricing and options next week for comparison.

calls.title: Byron Properties + Entrata ELI+ AI Suite Demo
calls.brief: Jon and Evan from Entrata, along with Tracy and Taylor from Byron Properties, discussed Entrata's AI suite, including leasing, payments, renewals, and maintenance AI, with a focus on how these tools can improve efficiency and resident experience. Byron Properties expressed particular interest in the maintenance AI for its potential to streamline maintenance requests and reduce the workload on their maintenance team. Entrata demonstrated the capabilities of each AI agent and addressed questions regarding customization, data integration, and resident communication.

calls.title: Byron Properties + Entrata Overview of Services
calls.brief: Evan from Entrata, along with Tracy and Taylor from Byron Properties, discussed Entrata's service offerings, including core bundles, resident experience enhancements, digital marketing, and AI capabilities, to determine a tailored solution for Byron Properties. They explored pricing, implementation timelines, and potential cost savings, with Byron Properties planning to evaluate other options before making a decision within the next two weeks. Evan will provide a detailed cost breakdown and schedule follow-up demos on AI, resident utility, and digital marketing.

calls.title: Demo # 2 Byron Properties + Entrata
calls.brief: Evan, Jon and Rolanda from Entrata, along with Taylor and Tracy from Byron Properties, discussed Entrata's capabilities in resident management, facilities, and accounting, focusing on automation and integration features that could improve Byron Properties' workflow. Byron Properties expressed interest in Entrata's automation of renewals, delinquency notices, and financial move-out processes, as well as the potential for improved vendor management and reporting. Next steps include a demo with Byron Properties' accountant, Alan, and further discussions on pricing, data migration, and implementation.

calls.title: Demo # 1 Byron Properties + Entrata
calls.brief: Evan, Jon and Rolanda from Entrata, along with Tracy and Taylor from Byron Properties, discussed Byron Properties' pain points with AppFolio, particularly regarding reporting, manual renewal processes, and lead tracking, and explored how Entrata's platform could address these issues through automation, AI-powered leasing tools, and comprehensive reporting. The Entrata team demonstrated key features like the dashboard, lead source attribution, AI virtual assistant, online leasing process, and resident management tools, highlighting the platform's customizability and potential for streamlining operations. Byron Properties expressed interest in Entrata's capabilities, especially regarding lead tracking, pet screening, and the potential for a more user-friendly experience compared to their current system.

calls.title: Entrata / Byron Properties
calls.brief: Evan and Ron from Entrata, along with Taylor from Byron Properties, discussed the potential for Byron Properties to switch from AppFolio to Entrata to streamline their property management operations, including leasing, reporting, and AI-driven solutions. Taylor is seeking a more robust system to support their current built-to-rent property and future expansion plans, with a focus on improving delinquency rates and renewal processes. Entrata aims to provide a comprehensive, all-in-one platform to support Byron Properties' growth and efficiency.

calls.title: Entrata & Cross Creek | Demo #2
calls.brief: Tyrus and Alex from Entrata, along with Ryan from Cross Creek Apartments, discussed Entrata's accounting features, reporting capabilities, and vendor management, comparing them to Cross Creek's current Appfolio system. Ryan expressed concerns about pricing, resident fees, and the timing of implementation given their Appfolio contract and ongoing property improvements, while Tyrus offered flexible solutions and a bundled pricing structure to address these concerns. Ultimately, they decided to move forward with a contract excluding the Utilities product, with plans for a scoping call to discuss implementation details.

calls.title: Cross Creek & Entrata | Proposal Review
calls.brief: Tyrus from Entrata, along with Brenda and Ryan from Cross Creek Apartments, discussed Entrata's core bundle pricing, implementation costs, and potential revenue-generating add-ons to meet minimum revenue requirements, as well as comparing Entrata's pricing with NM Residential. They also explored utilities and rewards programs as alternatives to increase revenue, and scheduled a follow-up call to discuss accounting and insurance details.

calls.title: Entrata + Kingston Properties Demo 3.0
calls.brief: Scott, David and Nate from Entrata, along with Jim from Kington Properties, discussed Entrata's move-in/move-out processes, utility billing services, and delinquency management tools, including Payments AI and rent credit reporting, as potential replacements for Kington Properties' current systems. Joseph and Brennan expressed frustration with Appfolio's incomplete features and pricing, while Jeffrey highlighted Entrata's unified platform, AI capabilities, and suitability for their growth plans, scheduling a follow-up demo to showcase Entrata's features. Both Joseph and Brennan are not in a rush to switch, but are open to exploring Entrata's capabilities.

calls.title: Entrata // SB Properties - Entrata Discussion
calls.brief: Oscar and Jeffrey from Entrata, along with Rommy from SB Properties, discussed SB Properties' potential switch from Appfolio to Entrata, focusing on Entrata's superior reporting, AI capabilities, and customer service. Rommy is seeking a user-friendly platform that can scale with potential future growth, and Jeffrey highlighted Entrata's unified system and potential for ancillary revenue to offset costs. A follow-up meeting was scheduled to explore the platform further after Rommy reviews a provided deck.

The Entrata team highlighted their system's lead tracking, task management, customizable dashboards, and automated contact points, while Gabriel focused on the practical application of these features for his leasing and maintenance staff. Despite time constraints, Entrata secured interest in a follow-up meeting to showcase resident management features.

calls.title: Hines & Entrata Call
calls.brief: Entrata team members, along with Ashley, Geri, Jason and Paula, discussed issues with rate publishing, amenity settings, and the need for more granular control over lease term pricing, particularly for renewals. Hines Management requested features to modify specific lease terms without redoing entire batches and to improve benchmarking options for renewal rates, while Entrata acknowledged the feedback and committed to further investigation and feature development. The teams also addressed specific issues at Maple Terrace Residences and Goose Creek, with Entrata offering assistance and committing to follow up on outstanding tickets.

calls.title: Hines & Entrata Call
calls.brief: Jessica, Mark, John and Alankrita from Entrata, along with Geri, Paula, Ashley, Jason and Frank, discussed issues with revenue intelligence, renewal rates, and the functionality of the system, including problems with publishing rates, data accuracy, and the need for enhanced reporting and filtering capabilities. They reviewed a prototype of an enhanced renewals office report and identified areas for improvement, and also addressed technical issues and timelines for upcoming releases and fixes. The Hines team requested several enhancements to improve the accuracy and efficiency of the system, particularly regarding renewal rate calculations and reporting.

White Oak Partners also requested a reference from a similar Entrata client to understand their transition experience.

Tim expressed interest in exploring Entrata's capabilities, particularly its AI integration and Yardi integration options, and agreed to stay in touch and consider attending Entrata's annual summit. They also discussed meeting at the upcoming NMHC's OPTEC conference in Washington, D.C.

calls.title: Maddy/Jamie lunch chat: Optima Inc/Entrata
calls.brief: Madison from Entrata, along with Jamie from Optima, Inc., discussed the possibility of Optima, Inc. switching back to Entrata from Yardi, focusing on Entrata's user-friendliness, customization, and improved CRM capabilities to enhance the high-touch resident experience at Optima's luxury properties. Jamie expressed interest in a demo refresh to evaluate Entrata's current features, particularly regarding lead management and automation, and a demo was scheduled for December 16th.

calls.title: RentPlus conversation+ Optima Inc.
calls.brief: Madison and Tyler from RentPlus presented their credit building and financial wellness program to Emily from Optima, highlighting its integration with RealPage, potential revenue generation, and minimal impact on Optima's team. Emily expressed interest in the program, particularly for specific properties, and will review the information with her team before a follow-up meeting to discuss potential implementation.

calls.title: Ripple - Entrata Scoping Call
calls.brief: Connor and Callin from Entrata, along with Alexes from Ripple, discussed the feasibility of migrating Ripple's single-family property portfolio to Entrata, but the call concluded that Entrata's inability to provide per-unit accounting, coupled with high per-property migration costs, made it a non-viable solution for Ripple's needs. Ripple is primarily focused on accounting and is not interested in other Entrata services.

calls.title: Ripple: Entrata Accounting demo
calls.brief: Libby and Connor from Entrata, along with Alexes from Ripple, discussed Ripple's needs for managing single-family homes and small unit properties, focusing on accounting, reporting, and payment processing. The call identified limitations in Entrata's ability to automate owner reporting and payments at the unit level, requiring potential workarounds or manual processes. Ripple plans to start with a small portfolio in Entrata and scale up, prioritizing accounting functionality for single-family owners.

calls.title: Chorus - Entrata // Ripple - Discussion
calls.brief: Connor and Oscar discussed Entrata's potential fit for Oscar's prop tech company, which manages a growing portfolio of primarily small multifamily and single-family units, with plans for significant expansion. Oscar is seeking an all-in-one solution, particularly for the owner experience, and is evaluating Entrata alongside other vendors, with a decision targeted for the end of the year, and a demo has been scheduled to further explore Entrata's capabilities.

calls.title: Chorus - Connor/Desmond: Entrata Pre-Demo Call
calls.brief: Connor from Entrata met with Realstar's IT team, Desmond and Khaled, to discuss Entrata's software and its potential integration with Realstar's existing Yardi system, focusing on data management, reporting capabilities, and compliance with the Ontario RTA. Connor highlighted Entrata's single data layer and comprehensive suite of tools, emphasizing its advantages over Yardi's separate systems, and scheduled an in-person demo to further explore these features.

calls.title: Chorus - Connor/Jack: Entrata Pre-Demo Call
calls.brief: Connor Patterson and Jack discussed Entrata's capabilities as a property management solution, focusing on its potential to replace Yardi and streamline accounting processes. Key topics included Entrata's single-login system, its growth in the Canadian market, and the challenges of transitioning from existing platforms, with an emphasis on the long-term benefits for both Realstar and its investors. They also touched on specific areas like AP automation, budgeting, revenue control, and capital project management, setting the stage for a more detailed in-person meeting.

calls.title: Connor/Jaime-Leigh: Agenda Review
calls.brief: Connor and Jamie discussed the upcoming Entrata demo for Realstar, focusing on tailoring the agenda and attendee list to address Realstar's key priorities, including website capabilities, CRM, lead source attribution, and AI integration, while also ensuring the platform's compatibility with operations in Quebec. They agreed to involve key stakeholders from various departments and to conduct deep discovery sessions with site team members to gather insights on their needs and challenges, with a follow-up demo planned for AI solutions.

calls.title: Connor/Jaime-Leigh | Entrata + Realstar
calls.brief: Connor from Entrata called Janie at Realstar to discuss Entrata's platform and how it could address Realstar's challenges in marketing, leasing, and data management, particularly in light of evolving search engine optimization and the need for a more integrated tech stack. Connor emphasized Entrata's AI capabilities, unified data layer, and potential to improve resident experience and internal training, while also suggesting a strategic approach to overcome resistance to change within the organization. The call concluded with plans for a demo, potentially involving Entrata's president, and a discussion of key stakeholders to include in the process.

calls.title: Realstar Tech Stack Review
calls.brief: Connor called Erica to understand Realstar's processes and how Entrata can assist them, aiming for an efficient demo of Entrata's CRM capabilities in a week, with a potential follow-up demo focused on resident management, maintenance, and operations. Erica highlighted challenges with their current systems, particularly staff resistance to new technology and data quality issues, while expressing interest in Entrata's CRM and AI-powered tools, but not in replacing their budgeting system at this time. Connor emphasized Entrata's focus on training, data integration, and AI solutions, positioning Entrata as a potential single-source-of-truth solution for Realstar's front-end operations, while integrating with their existing Yardi Voyager accounting system.

calls.title: Boardwalk | Entrata
calls.brief: Jed and Miles discussed Entrata's potential fit for Jed's company, focusing on marketing features and pricing, with Jed expressing concerns about the cost for their smaller portfolio. Miles highlighted Entrata's integrated platform and potential revenue-generating programs, and they scheduled a follow-up meeting with Jed's team to further evaluate Entrata against competitors like AppFolio and RealPage. Jed is primarily focused on marketing improvements and lead tracking, and is looking for a system that is better than their current system, Propertyware.

calls.title: Boardwalk | Intro to Entrata
calls.brief: The call was a comprehensive demo of Entrata for a small, family-owned property management company looking to upgrade from Propertyware, focusing on lead management, website capabilities, and CRM features. Phone Caller #2 expressed concerns about the system's complexity for their size but was impressed with its capabilities, particularly lead source tracking and potential for AI integration, and requested a proposal for consideration after Labor Day. Entrata highlighted its all-in-one platform, customizable features, and robust support system, emphasizing its ability to scale with the client's business and improve marketing effectiveness.

calls.title: Trinity Management & Entrata | Demo #1
calls.brief:
Here is a brief synopsis of the call:

Entrata presented its all-in-one property management solution to Yuri from Pulse Capital, highlighting its integrated database, task-driven dashboard, and automated accounting and resident ledger features as superior to Buildium and other competitors like MRI and RealPage. Yuri expressed interest in Entrata's intuitive interface and shorter implementation timeline compared to MRI, and the next steps involve internal demos and a proposal call to discuss pricing and product usage. The call concluded with scheduling a follow-up sync call in two weeks and addressing the need for an NDA due to call recordings.

calls.title: Entrata / Todorovic Capital
calls.brief: The call was an initial discovery session to determine if Entrata is a good fit for Trinity Management, a company managing around 312 units in New York. Tyrus gathered information about their current software (Buildium), operational structure, and growth plans to assess Entrata's suitability, emphasizing the need for accurate unit counts and property details to meet revenue minimums and tailor a product demo. Tyrus will send a follow-up email with questions, a recap, and demo videos to help Yuri and his team evaluate Entrata further.

calls.title: Chorus - Jake|Lisa - Contract Questions
calls.brief: Jacob discussed Entrata's software package with Phone Caller #1, addressing pricing, features, and implementation details, while also acknowledging their past negative experience with Yardi. Phone Caller #1 is evaluating Entrata as a potential replacement for Yardi and needs to determine the cost of integration before making a decision in about six months, after consulting with stakeholders. Jacob offered further support, including additional demos and a scoping call to assess the timeline and rollout plan.

calls.title: Entrata|Churchill - Discuss Application Workflow
calls.brief: Veronica met with Entrata representatives to discuss integrating their software with Churchill's application process, focusing on using TAA forms and streamlining the online application experience. Key discussion points included the integration of Blue Moon forms, particularly the supplemental rental application (SRA) and affordable housing addendum, as well as scheduling a scoping call to discuss implementation and address any remaining questions. The Entrata team will follow up on the SRA and affordable housing components and provide a summary email with a proposed timeline.

calls.title: Entrata|Churchill - Accounting Demo (Part 2)
calls.brief: "Jacob and Phone Caller #1 from Entrata provided Michelle with an overview of Entrata's accounting, reporting, budgeting, security, and implementation processes, addressing her specific concerns and questions. The discussion covered GL setup, financial reporting, month-end close, budgeting options, security features, implementation timelines, data migration, and training resources, with a focus on how Entrata can streamline Michelle's current workflows and address her pain points."

calls.title: Entrata|Churchill Residential - Accounting Demo
calls.brief: The call was a software demo focused on the accounting features of Entrata, with Michelle from the client side expressing interest in Accounts Receivable (AR), Accounts Payable (AP), administrative accounting, and month-end financial reporting. Key discussion points included Entrata's integration with NetVendor and Avid, its real-time General Ledger (GL) posting, approval workflows, automation of lease charges, and intercompany transaction handling. A follow-up call was scheduled for Tuesday to cover GL setup, chart of accounts, month-end close, financial reporting, budgeting, and security.

calls.title: Chorus - Entrata|Churchill Residential - Full Platform Overview Demo
calls.brief: The Entrata team presented their property management software to Churchville, highlighting its resident-centric design, automation capabilities, and integration of various functions like marketing, CRM, and accounting, aiming to replace Yardi due to gaps in affordable and on-site management. Churchville expressed interest in Entrata's features, particularly those related to affordable housing compliance, waitlist management, and streamlined workflows, and the teams discussed implementation timelines, pricing structures, and potential next steps for a full transition.

calls.title: Connor + Paul | Entrata + Minto
calls.brief: Connor from Entrata contacted Paul at Minto to discuss their tech stack and potential solutions Entrata could offer. Minto is conducting a tech stack review for 2026, focusing on AI leasing agents, application portals, and renewal processes, while Entrata aims to showcase its unified platform and AI capabilities to streamline Minto's operations, particularly in the lead-to-lease process. Both parties agreed to further discussions and a potential meeting to explore Entrata's offerings.

calls.title: Entrata + Minto: Tech Review

Brendan is leaving Minto soon and will introduce Paul Vandertal to Connor for a smooth handoff, with a potential Entrata Summit visit for key decision-makers being discussed. The company is budgeting for major operational changes in 2026, with some smaller projects potentially addressed this year.

They discussed Entrata's features, pricing, and implementation timeline, with a follow-up demo planned in three to four weeks.

They agreed to provide their financial setup and reporting needs for a more tailored demonstration in a follow-up meeting.

calls.title: Kandas + Connor | Colonnade + Entrata
calls.brief: Connor, from Entrata, initiated a call with a Colonnade Bridgeport Project Manager to introduce Entrata's property management platform and explore potential opportunities for collaboration, particularly as Colonnade's residential portfolio grows. Connor highlighted Entrata's integrated, user-friendly system as an alternative to Colonnade's current Yardi-based setup, suggesting it could streamline front-end operations and address challenges associated with rapid expansion. Both parties agreed to stay in touch for future consideration as Colonnade's needs evolve.

calls.brief: Shelly updated Caleb on the closed deal and the upcoming software vendor selection, noting Entrata's disadvantage due to a lack of proven track record in their market. calls.brief: Caleb presented Entrata's software solutions to Shelly, focusing on core features, ancillary revenue opportunities, and implementation options, while Shelly explored the product's capabilities, pricing, and integration potential compared to their current system, Yardi. Shelly expressed interest but emphasized the importance of understanding the learning curve, product offerings, and integration capabilities before making a decision, with a follow-up call scheduled for April 10th to discuss further.

calls.title: WBourne + Entrata
calls.brief: Connor connected with Peter from Woodburn to discuss how Entrata can better serve their needs, particularly regarding Business Intelligence (BI) and data management for their student housing portfolio. They explored integrating Entrata's BI tools with Woodburn's existing Power BI system to streamline reporting and improve data-driven decision-making, while also touching on upcoming Entrata features for the Canadian market and potential future collaborations for their multifamily portfolio. Peter suggested Steve as the primary contact for further discussions on the Rhapsody portfolio.

calls.title: Connor + Ian | Entrata + WBourne
calls.brief: Connor from Entrata connected with Ian to discuss how Entrata's AI-powered BI tools can improve property management and asset management, particularly in student housing. Ian expressed interest in aggregating data from various property management systems used across Woodbourne's portfolio and offered to connect Connor with Steve Cordes, who is more directly involved in the technical implementation of such systems. They also discussed the student housing market in Kingston and Woodbourne's recent property sales and upcoming developments.

calls.title: TM Real Estate + Entrata (Intro Call)
calls.brief: Evan, a senior analyst, spoke with Entrata to explore alternatives to RealPage, focusing on Entrata's integrated platform and customizable reporting. Entrata highlighted their competitive pricing, data migration support, and flexible implementation options, while Evan expressed concerns about the conversion process and the need to assess manager pain points before making a decision. The call concluded with Entrata offering further information and a potential follow-up in a few months.

Mike expressed interest in exploring these options to improve efficiency for his staff and residents, particularly in the context of affordable housing, and agreed to schedule a follow-up meeting with Angie, who can provide insights into the daily challenges. Miles offered a proposal for the products, priced at $2 per unit per month combined, and emphasized Entrata's local presence and partnership opportunities.

calls.title: Entrata + Eucalyptus | Pre-Demo Call
calls.brief: The Entrata team met with a prospective client to understand their pain points with RealPage, focusing on issues with reporting, multi-property management, website implementation, and overall user experience. The client expressed a need for a more integrated and customizable system, particularly for accounting and operational workflows, and Entrata proposed an in-person demo to showcase their platform's capabilities. The client agreed to schedule the in-person demo.

Entrata presented itself as a transparent partner with a simpler pricing structure and a commitment to customer service, proposing a follow-up call with Megan's team to gather feedback and schedule an in-person demo. The goal is to potentially transition Eucalyptus Real Estate to Entrata by the end of the year.
